en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to wear a white quilted cap, and he<sup>saww</sup> was wearing it during the battle, a cape which had two ear-coverings for it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, wore a white cape which was quilted. And for the war time he would wear one which had two ears.’”
